name: Locust
description: The pan's fast chaff, and the one body in the game that moves by leaping: the game runs it as 0.3s at 265 and half a second at almost nothing (EnemyType.hopSpeed), drawn as height with `ss.fx.shadow` under it. So the silhouette is the leg — one enormous hind femur cocked up and back with the tibia folded under it, a wedge of a body in front, wings laid flat along the back. Bile-green, the arsenal's acid colour turned into an animal, and nothing else on the pan is green but the Forerunner, which is a boss and four times the size. Drawn side-on facing +x, mirrored by the game. The `hop` clip is the leap: the leg kicks straight and the body pitches up, then folds back; it plays at its own rate rather than in step with the game's hops, which is fine for a loop whose whole read is a leg going in and out. Gameplay radius 7. No `elite` variant: a Locust is never the sturdiest thing on its stage. The `death` clip kicks once into nothing and then draws the leg up under the body while the wing falls open.

hop.description: the hind leg cocks and kicks straight, the wing lifts on the kick and the whole body pitches up, then it folds back under and the small legs catch the ground; antennae whip

death.description: one kick into nothing, then the hind leg draws up under the body, the wing falls open, the head drops and the antennae lie down over it, and the organ flares out
